new_candidates.name: Trendlyne
new_candidates.deal_content: Aggregates BSE/NSE corporate announcements into one searchable, filterable, alertable stream (acquisitions, scheme of arrangement, open offers, board approvals), plus corporate actions, bulk/block deals and shareholding-pattern changes that flag stake building. English throughout.
new_candidates.history_depth: Multi-year announcement and corporate-action archive (site does not publish an explicit start year; depth not verified).
new_candidates.price: Free tier; paid plans quoted by third-party reviews at approx INR 2,190/yr (GuruQ) and INR 5,900/yr (StratQ), i.e. roughly USD 25-70/yr. Prices not confirmed on Trendlyne's own pricing page - verify before purchase.
new_candidates.api: No public/documented API found. Screens and announcement lists are exportable/viewable in-browser only.
new_candidates.clause_verbatim: You may not resell, redistribute, broadcast or transfer the information or use the information in a searchable, machine-readable database unless separately and specifically authorized in writing by trendlyne.com ... You may not rent, lease, sublicense, distribute, transfer, copy, reproduce, publicly display, publish, adapt, store or time-share trendlyne.com
new_candidates.why_it_adds_value: Turns the raw BSE/NSE announcement firehose into a filterable, alert-driven feed in English - materially faster for deal screening than the exchange portals - at a trivial price. BUT the terms bar putting the information into 'a searchable, machine-readable database' without written consent, which is exactly the intended internal use; the T&C are silent on scraping as such, so the binding constraint is the downstream-database clause, not the extraction method. Would need written permission from Trendlyne to use as an internal data source; usable now only for manual analyst lookup.

new_candidates.price: Free 'Hobby Investor' tier (no announcements feature, no Excel export); Premium INR 4,999/yr incl. GST (approx USD 60) with announcements, 800 stock alerts, screen download and Excel automation.
new_candidates.clause_verbatim: Permission is granted to use the materials (information or software) on Site for personal, non-commercial transitory viewing only. ... modify or copy the materials; use the materials for any commercial purpose ... transfer the materials to another person or 'mirror' the materials on any other server
new_candidates.why_it_adds_value: Cheapest structured announcement search in India with a native Excel export path, and its screens can surface acquirer/target candidates the exchange portals cannot. However the licence is 'personal, non-commercial transitory viewing only' and expressly bars commercial use, copying and mirroring - so for a fee-earning M&A practice it is at best an analyst reference tool, not a feed. Terms are silent on crawling/bots; the commercial-use bar is the blocker.

new_candidates.name: SFC Takeovers - Executive decisions and statements (+ Takeovers Bulletin)
new_candidates.deal_content: Curated, M&A-specific regulatory output: Takeovers Executive rulings and statements on general/partial offers, whitewash waivers, concert-party and chain-principle findings, cold-shoulder orders and public censures under the Codes on Takeovers and Mergers and Share Buy-backs, plus the periodic Takeovers Bulletin. Every entry is a real HK control transaction or a dispute arising from one.
new_candidates.history_depth: Back to 7 April 2000; latest entry seen 16 February 2026. Roughly 26 years of continuous coverage.
new_candidates.api: No. Browsable chronological list with individual PDFs; no bulk download or documented API.
new_candidates.clause_verbatim: Unless otherwise stated, all copyright and other intellectual property rights in the materials on this website belong to the SFC. ... may be downloaded or printed for personal use or for use within an individual firm or organisation ... may not be reproduced for or distributed to third parties, or used for commercial purposes, without the SFC's prior written consent. Consent is not required where extracts of no more than a few relevant paragraphs are to be copied to third parties incidental to advice or other activities, provided that the source is properly acknowledged.
new_candidates.why_it_adds_value: HKEXnews carries the issuer's own announcement; this carries the regulator's characterisation of the same transaction - concert parties, waivers, deemed-offer triggers - which is the part that matters for precedent and for identifying who really controls a target. Condition: download for use WITHIN the firm is expressly permitted (which covers an internal analytical database), while onward distribution to third parties or commercial exploitation needs consent, with a carve-out for short attributed extracts in client advice. Terms are silent on crawling per se; observe robots.txt and rate limits as a matter of prudence.

new_candidates.history_depth: Not disclosed on site; per-stock news lists appear to run for several years. Depth NOT verified.
new_candidates.price: Free (premium real-time quote products are separate).
new_candidates.clause_verbatim: The subscriber or app/website visitor agrees not to reproduce, retransmit, disseminate, distribute, broadcast, publish, circulate, sell or commercially exploit the information and contents on this app/website in any manner without the express written consent of AASTOCKS.com Limited.
new_candidates.why_it_adds_value: Adds an English-language, per-stock view of HKEX filings that is easier to poll than HKEXnews's search form, and bundles a news wire that often reports a deal before the formal filing. No explicit robots/scraping clause was found in the disclaimer, but the reproduction bar is broad. Treat as a manual monitoring aid, not a feed.

new_candidates.name: Kaohoon International
new_candidates.deal_content: English-language Thai capital-markets news desk: covers SET-listed company acquisitions, tender offers, IPO filings, broker actions and cross-border deals involving Thai corporates. Editorial/curated rather than a filing mirror.

new_candidates.why_it_adds_value: SET's own announcement stream is overwhelmingly Thai-language; this is the main free English narrative layer over Thai deal flow, which makes triage possible for non-Thai-speaking advisers and often names the parties and rationale before the filing translation appears. Caveat: only a privacy policy was locatable (footer reads '(c) KAOHOON. All Rights Reserved.'); no terms-of-use page was found, so the automated-access stance is genuinely unknown - do not assume permission. Also note it is secondary reporting, so it is a lead-generation source, not a source of record.

new_candidates.history_depth: Multi-year disclosure archive per ticker; explicit start year not published. NOT verified.
new_candidates.price: Free tier covers the disclosure sections (site prompts 'Bạn đang sử dụng phiên bản Free'); premium tiers exist for analytics. Well under USD 3k/yr.
new_candidates.why_it_adds_value: Single cross-exchange search over HOSE + HNX + UPCoM, which the exchange portals cannot do - HOSE and HNX must otherwise be queried separately, and UPCoM (where much unlisted-company M&A surfaces) is poorly served. Adds shareholder-document coverage too. Caveat: the terms page at /dieu-khoan-su-dung renders its body via JavaScript and could not be read by fetch, reader proxy or raw HTML parsing, so the stance is unknown; the only recoverable statements are the meta robots tag 'index,follow,all' and the footer '(c) Bản quyền thuộc về Vietstock'. Operator: CTCP Tài Việt. Read the terms in a real browser before any automated collection.

new_candidates.why_it_adds_value: Covers the part of Vietnamese deal flow the exchanges miss - private and unlisted transactions, foreign-buyer entries, and stake sales reported before or without a filing - with roughly two decades of searchable archive at zero cost.
